. Writers on Rhetoric usually divide prose composition into कथा and आख्यायिका and make a distinction between them. Thus they regard Bāṇa's हर्षचरित as an आख्यायिका and कादंबरी as a कथा; according to Daṇḍin, however, (
) there is no distinction between the two; तत्कथाख्यायिकेत्येका जातिः संज्ञाद्वयाङ्किता
